dct_title_s: Cumberland County, New Jersey highways 1967 map 1
dct_description_sm: Base map of Cumberland County. Plate 1 of a 7 plate map. Prepared by the New Jersey State Highway Department, Division of Planning in cooperation with the U. S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Public Roads. Series includes 10 insets of major junctures. State highways as of Dec. 31, 1967. Culture, county roads and municipal streets as of 1940.
